title: The European Commission says "X has submitted remedies in relation to its blue check mark" in the EU and the commission will "assess" the proposed remedies (Gian Volpicelli/Bloomberg)
summary: Gian Volpicelli / Bloomberg: The European Commission says “X has submitted remedies in relation to its blue check mark” in the EU and the commission will “assess” the proposed remedies — Elon Musk's X, the social network formerly known as Twitter, has agreed to change its verification mechanism …
contentText:
Gian Volpicelli / Bloomberg :

The European Commission says “X has submitted remedies in relation to its blue check mark” in the EU and the commission will “assess” the proposed remedies   —  Elon Musk's X, the social network formerly known as Twitter, has agreed to change its verification mechanism …
